_comment: PROPOSED decisions, transcribed from the researcher's 19 September priority message and DECODER_PILOT_DESIGN_20260919.md. plan.py never defaults these; the author confirms or edits this file and it is then sealed by 'plan.py register-tuning'. Remove this _comment key before use.
fallback_policy: If the bounded GPU pilot measures a step time above 5 s or peak memory above the 24 GiB card, do not run the full matrix: first narrow the decoder study (fewer tuning points, then two seeds reported as such, then drop the bracket), and only if the decoder is infeasible fall back to matched LoRA/PiSSA on the existing RTE/MRPC protocol. Frozen before any confirmation outcome is seen.
decision_provenance: Researcher priority message of 19 September 2026 (decoder before CENTER; Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on GSM8K; UNREG/MIX/NORM/LoRA/PiSSA; three seeds; shared q/o projection scope; exact match primary) together with DECODER_PILOT_DESIGN_20260919.md section 5. Tail size 512 and MIX dose 1e-3 are the design defaults and are still open for the author to change before registration.
